items.name: Agent FM
items.one_liner: One group chat to hear and steer your coding agents.
items.description: Agent FM is a desktop app that gives engineers one group chat to hear and steer their coding agents. Instead of manually bouncing between different claude code and codex sessions, and combing through walls of text to monitor agents, engineers just tune in to Agent FM. Agents share important progress updates, blockers, assumptions, and decisions in the group chat. Engineers get live text and audio updates and respond right from the chat.

items.name: SpaceFlow Technologies, Inc.
items.one_liner: The managed runtime for enterprise AI agents
items.description:
SpaceFlow is the managed runtime for AI agents that execute supply chain work across ERPs, email, spreadsheets, documents, and supplier portals. It turns fragmented operational data and SOPs into a governed context layer, then gives agents reusable skills and controlled access to enterprise tools.

SpaceFlow agents normalize multi-round quotations, chase suppliers and delivery confirmations, repair incomplete requests, classify materials, reconcile phantom inventory, surface market signals, and help sales and operations planning teams continuously align demand, supply, inventory, purchasing deadlines, and freight decisions.

SpaceFlow deploys in the customer’s cloud or on-prem environment with permissions, human approvals, observability, and audit trails, allowing industrial and regulated enterprises to automate high-stakes operations without replacing existing systems or moving sensitive data.

items.name: Trident
items.description: Traditional security tools drown teams in useless alerts and logs. Trident chains vulnerabilities together like a real attacker, mapping verified attack paths across AWS, Azure, GCP, web apps, and APIs to show the exploits that actually cause business impact

items.name: Amorphic Labs
items.one_liner: Agentic, Personalized Product Demo Videos for Sales
items.description: We build agents that create personalized product demo videos for tailored outbound, qualifying inbound, and call follow ups. Provide a list of prospects and our agent will research each prospect, use your app to record a tailored demo workflow complete with personalized seeded data, edit and narrate the video, then output a polished demo video ready to send.

items.name: OpenVector
items.one_liner: AI that turns any camera to an autonomous worker with real-time vision
items.description: OpenVector transforms any existing camera into an automated 24/7 workforce without requiring new hardware. Users simply describe a task in plain English, and OpenVector automatically builds a custom AI vision model to monitor the feed. When it detects an important physical event—like a stalled production cycle, a safety violation, or a waiting customer—it operates a computer just like a human to take immediate action. It integrates with legacy systems to make calls, send emails, update a POS/CRM, or trigger webhooks in real time. OpenVector enables any camera to do real work.

items.name: COACH
items.one_liner: The AI Coach for in person sales reps.
items.description:
Coach is the AI sales coach for in-person sales teams.

Reps record every meeting, and our AI figures out what your best closers do differently, then coaches everyone else to do the same, with precise, personalized feedback after every meeting. 

Managers finally see 100% of what happens in the field: Coach flags who's stuck and why, so they only step in when it matters, and can coach 5× more reps.

And every meeting feeds one sales brain, so leadership finally gets answers to the questions that used to be guesswork. They finally see the game of their team not just the scoreboard.

Our bet: in the AI era, in-person sales will only matter more. It may end up being one of the last truly human jobs.

Our conviction: any motivated rep can become a great one, meeting after meeting.

The results so far: +32% average lift in conversion rate.

COΛCH, post-game video analysis for field sales reps. YC S26

items.name: Stratum Industries
items.one_liner: AI agents that clear the U.S. government backlog.
items.description:
Stratum builds AI agents that clear the U.S. government backlog. Every permit, license, patent, drug approval, and benefits claim in America has to be reviewed by a government adjudicator and the software they rely on was built decades before AI. The result is millions of applications stuck in queues: veterans waiting on disability ratings, families waiting on pensions, builders waiting years to break ground.

Stratum replaces that workflow. A reviewer drops in an application, selects the rubric it needs to be checked against, and an agent plans, executes, and reviews the file end to end routing each step to the right model for the most accurate and cost-efficient decision. Hundreds of agents run in parallel in the cloud, with a human kept in the loop to approve and full auditability at every step, so an entire backlog can be cleared in the time it used to take to review a single file.

We're rebuilding the entire infrastructure the government runs on both the reviewer side and the applicant side - so filing and adjudication become instant instead of taking weeks.

We're Vihaan and Raj, brothers. Vihaan was founding engineer #3 at Cadastral (acquired by Legora) and dropped out of Waterloo to build Stratum. Raj led GTM at Deel, averaging 220% of quota over two years and ranking top 5 of 1,000+ reps globally, and dropped out of grad school at the University of Bath to build Stratum.

items.name: Executor
items.one_liner: The open source integration management layer for AI.
items.description:
Executor.sh is an MCP gateway that allows you to sign in once to all of your integrations and use them with any client.

We enable you to connect your agents to anything (MCP, GraphQL, OpenAPI) so regardless of what you're trying to connect agents to you're able to.

If you're trying to scale agents to access all of your production services, data, etc, you need Executor as a unified management layer.

items.name: Buildbox
items.one_liner: Understand how users experience your AI agents
items.description: Buildbox helps product teams improve the human-agent experience. We analyze user intent, agent behavior, and outcomes to find where users get stuck or lose trust, then turn those findings into ranked, reproducible issues.

items.name: Rindler
items.one_liner: Middleware making websites readable for AI agents
items.description:
Rindler turns any website, including sites without APIs, into a deterministic API that AI agents can reliably use. It handles logins, 2FA, and bot detection, giving agents clean structured data and dependable actions instead of raw HTML, with robust maintenance when sites change.

Rindler is agent-agnostic and built on the open MCP standard, so it works with any agent.

For operators: get your team out of portals and back to the work that matters.

For agent builders: let your agents act on the real web quickly, cheaply, and reliably on every run.

items.name: Agnost AI
items.one_liner: Product analytics for teams building conversational agents
items.description:
Agnost AI helps teams building chat and voice AI agents understand what users want, where they get stuck, and why they drop off.

We read production AI conversations, cluster recurring intents, feature requests, frustration, and failure patterns, then open PRs against prompts, tools, and harnesses to improve the agent.

items.name: Amulet
items.description:
Amulet helps post-sales teams monitor every account and automate the work that drives retention and expansion.

Our agents connect to customer data (CRM, support, product usage, and communication data) to flag churn risks, surface upsell opportunities, track adoption, and draft the right messages for each customer.

items.name: Tell if AI
items.one_liner: AI agents on real phones, growing brands across every platform.
items.description: An AI-run performance marketing agency. We deploy autonomous agents on a fleet of real mobile phones that create, post, and grow content across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, Reddit and more operating hundreds of accounts in parallel, indistinguishable from human creators. Brands hire us the way they'd hire a growth agency, but instead of a team of marketers we run the entire pipeline autonomously: ideation, video production, posting, engagement, and audience building. We get paid on revenue share, so our incentives are aligned with our partners' growth. Our first partnership is revenue sharing with a telehealth clinic, where we're driving patient acquisition across dozens of channels we built and operate end-to-end.
